newsitem.title: USA: Quaker assigns cereal ads to Foote Cone.
newsitem.headline: Quaker assigns cereal ads to Foote Cone.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co said Wednesday it assigned advertising responsibility for four of its cereal brands to Foote Cone & Belding Chicago, which is part of True North Communications Inc.
Foote Cone is now the agency of record for all of Quaker Cereals.
Advertising for Quaker Oats oatmeal, Instant Quaker Oatmeal, Life and Quaker 100% Natural cereal brands were switched to Foote Cone from Jordan McGrath Case Taylor, New York, Quaker said.

Other brands that had been handled by Foote Cone include Cap'n Crunch cereal and Cap'n Crunch Bar, Quaker Bagged Cereals, Quaker Toasted Oatmeal ready-to-eat cereal and Quick 'n Hearty microwavable oatmeal. Combined, these Quaker Foods brands represent about $100 million in advertising media expenditures.
Foote Cone also has the advertising responsibility for Quaker's beverage brands, Gatorade and Snapple, Quaker said.
The company said the assignment for its Aunt Jemima mixes and syrup, now held by Jordan McGrath, will be put up for review.
Jordan McGrath will retain their current agency of record media buying assignment for Quaker Beverages, it added.

"We believe this integration of creative, media planning and media buying with one agency, Foote Cone & Belding, will give us greater leverage in the marketplace," Douglas Mills, executive vice president - U.S. and Canadian Quaker Foods. "Foote Cone & Belding provides the scale, creativity and resources we need and their Quaker experience and physical proximity make them ideal business partners."
